final_message:
I made one CSS fix for a broken-image problem on the catalog cards. I haven't confirmed it visually, because I didn't regenerate the screenshots or read any after-change image.

I read all six screenshots (desktop and mobile for catalog, booking and requests). The BMW card in the catalog showed the browser's plain "Image unavailable" text at the top-left, overlapping the "Available" badge. Its image box was also shorter than the other two cards. The booking and requests screens looked fine, so I left them alone.

The fix is in `src/styles/app.css`. The card image box now clips overflow, and the placeholder fills the box with centered, muted text. The placeholder no longer sets its own aspect ratio, so card heights should stay consistent.

`npm run build` passed. I didn't run the unit tests or Playwright checks.

I couldn't tell from the screenshot whether the BMW image URL is genuinely broken or the screenshot was taken while it was still loading. If the URL is broken, that is in the seed data or server, which I'm not allowed to edit.

I wrote `quality/polish.md` and made no claim of final visual approval.
